## 1. Stages (slides 2-6)

- [W01-001] | Evaporation: liquid water turns into water vapour, driven by heat from the sun | Definition | 3
- [W01-002] | Condensation: water vapour cools and turns into tiny droplets, which form clouds | Definition | 4
- [W01-003] | Precipitation: water falls from clouds as rain, snow, sleet or hail | Definition | 5
- [W01-004] | Collection: water gathers in oceans, lakes, rivers and underground | Definition | 6
- [W01-005] | The four stages in order: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection | Ranking | 2

## 2. Extras (slides 7-10)

- [W01-006] | Transpiration: plants release water vapour through their leaves; evaporation and transpiration together are called evapotranspiration | Definition | 7
- [W01-007] | About 97% of Earth's water is salt water in the oceans | Statistic | 8
- [W01-008] | Runoff: water flowing over land into streams and rivers | Definition | 9
- [W01-009] | Infiltration: water soaking into the ground and becoming groundwater | Definition | 9
- [W01-010] | Sublimation: ice turns directly into vapour without becoming liquid first | Definition | 10
